bugs.title: Pasted production.json still shows "received part one" — replace with receiving animation
bugs.notes: Split production.json paste UX: while receiving split bubbles, show a 'Receiving .json file...' style indicator (never a partial/'part one' message); resolve cleanly to success once fully assembled. Reported a third time (prior bug-27/bug-38 'done' statuses NOT trusted) — re-investigate from current code. [STARTED 2026-08-28 sweep: investigating current paste-assembly code from scratch.] [DONE 2026-08-28 sweep, commit 99ca97d]: ROOT CAUSE confirmed — the split-paste branch still called renderFreshView with "Received part N ... Send the rest of the JSON" per fragment, posting a fresh partial-receipt bubble each time (the exact "part one" UX reported a third time; bug-27/bug-38 only suppressed it post-assembly, never removed the per-fragment partial message). FIX in bot/src/index.js: (1) while looksLikePartialJson(joined) is true, the handler now edits ONE persistent indicator message ("⏳ Receiving .json file…" + indeterminateBar + "assembling pasted plan — this resolves automatically."), with NO fragment count and NO "send the rest"; its message_id is persisted as pending.jsonIndicatorId so successive bubbles edit the same indicator instead of spawning new messages, and the fragment handler returns {ok:true} without rendering any fresh view. (2) On assembly completion the indicator message is deleted alongside the raw split bubbles, so no residual message remains — only showTask. (3) After successful validation, jsonIndicatorId/jsonBuffer/jsonBubbleIds are cleared from flow state. VERIFIED: node --check clean; bot suite 53 pass with 4 failures CONFIRMED PRE-EXISTING (identical 4 not-ok with the change stashed). HONEST LIMITS: no live Telegram end-to-end run possible in sandbox; indicator edit-in-place behavior mirrors the existing renderInteractiveView activeViewId pattern and deleteMessage is the same call already used for the raw bubbles.

bugs.title: Zero-setup cloning — bot auto-creates the GitHub repo via API from the user's PAT
bugs.notes: Remove requirement that the user manually create a GitHub repo before cloning. New flow: user provides GitHub PAT + optional repo name (or bot auto-names); bot creates the repo via GitHub API using the PAT, then proceeds with clone setup against it. Must verify PAT scope allows repo creation; note clearly if not. [STARTED 2026-08-28: reading clone-setup flow and probing PAT repo-creation capability.] [DONE 2026-08-28, commit 3eb2f92]: FINDINGS: the prior flow ALREADY created the repo via POST /user/repos from the user PAT (createPrivateShadowClone in github.js), but forced the user to type a valid name and crashed unhandled if creation failed. The manual-creation requirement was therefore a UX gap, not a missing capability. FIX: (1) clone:new prompt now offers a "✨ Choose a name for me" button (clone:newauto) which seeds flow gh_pat_new with cloneName='' as the auto-name sentinel; handleClonePatMessage no longer treats empty cloneName as an expired flow (checks undefined/null instead). (2) github.js autoCloneRepositoryName() picks a free clipforge-clone-<6char> name by probing GET /repos/<login>/<candidate> for 404 before anything is created, so no half-created repo on collision. (3) createPrivateShadowClone wraps the POST /user/repos 403/404 in a clear "token cannot create repositories — classic PAT needs repo scope, fine-grained needs Administration write" error, and handleClonePatMessage catches creation errors and renders them with a retry button instead of throwing. PAT PERMISSION NOTE (required by prompt): the session PAT is a fine-grained token (login motionssalt, verified via GET /user 200) — fine-grained PATs do not expose X-OAuth-Scopes, so repo-creation capability cannot be pre-proven without creating a real repo; the only true test is POST /user/repos itself, which the bot now performs and reports on honestly. I deliberately did NOT create a throwaway repo on the production account to probe. VERIFIED: node --check clean on both files; bot suite 53 pass / 4 pre-existing failures (unchanged); auto-name logic simulated in Node (format + collision-skip loop). LIMITS: no live GitHub end-to-end clone creation run from sandbox; API call shapes reused from the already-working createPrivateShadowClone.

bugs.title: News-push feature to clones, with optional recurring interval (min 6h)
bugs.notes: Main account can push a 'news' message to all connected clone deployments. One-off push + optional recurring push on a set interval (minimum 6 hours). Settings UI/flow at implementer's judgment; scheduling likely via scheduled GitHub Actions workflow or Cloudflare Worker cron, matching existing scheduled-behavior architecture (e.g. Zernio smart schedule). [STARTED 2026-08-28: designing news-push on the existing clone-sync/notice architecture + Cloudflare cron.] [DONE 2026-08-28, commit bba870e]: DESIGN: direct push into clone KV/Telegram is impossible (main has no access to clone bots), so the broadcast rides the SAME proven channel as the bug-39 update notice: a docs/news.json file in the source repo that every clone reads. IMPLEMENTATION: (1) Settings → GitHub clone (main owner only, same originalRepo gate as publish-update) gains "📰 Push news to clones" → news menu with current message + recurring status. (2) Compose (set:news:compose) starts a news_message flow; the text is written to docs/news.json with a fresh published_at. (3) Interval buttons 6h/12h/24h/off (set:news:int:N); anything below 6h except 0 is rejected (NEWS_MIN_INTERVAL_HOURS=6). (4) Clone side: commands/start.js announceNews() reads docs/news.json from motionssalt/clipforge on every home-screen open and sends "📰 News from ClipForge" once per published_at marker (per-chat KV key news_notice in storage.js) — main-account chat also sees it (it reads the same source path; harmless). (5) Recurring: new .github/workflows/news-push.yml cron "37 */6 * * *" (guarded if: repository==motionssalt/clipforge so clones no-op) re-bumps published_at when interval_hours>=6 has elapsed, which triggers re-announcement everywhere. GITHUB_TOKEN only — no Cloudflare/third-party secrets needed. VERIFIED: node --check clean on index/storage/start; news-push.yml parses as YAML; bot suite unchanged (53 pass / 4 pre-existing fails). LIMITS: no live cross-deployment run; cron is 6-hourly so a 6h interval re-broadcasts within 6-12h worst case (documented in the menu copy).

bugs.title: Series tasks must not expire until the entire series is complete
bugs.notes: Current 12h task expiry (per prior bug-03/bug-37) appears to apply per-part even in series mode. For series-mode tasks, no part of an incomplete series may be cleaned up/expired until every part reaches a completed/terminal state. Must not break general (non-series) expiry/cleanup behavior.

bugs.title: Remove the series-mode toggle from the /new task-creation flow
bugs.notes: Series mode is controlled as a default/setting in main Settings (already exists there), not a per-task choice. Remove the series toggle/option from the /new wizard entirely; task creation follows the current Settings value without asking per task.
